newsitem.title: USA: Bway Corp issues $100 mln in 10-year debt.
newsitem.headline: Bway Corp issues $100 mln in 10-year debt.

text.p: The following debt issue from Bway Corp was priced in the 144A private placement market on Tuesday, according to a high-yield market source.
Atlanta, Ga-based Bway is a leading manufacturer of metal containers for paints, solvents, and household products in North America.
BT Securities Corp was lead manager on the deal.
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 10/15/97 LAST MOODY'S B2 YIELD 10.25 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P SINGLE-B CALLABLE NON-CALL FIVE
NOTE: Three year equity call for 1/3 deal at par plus coupon. ((--U.S. Corporate Bond Unit, 212 859-1672))
